newsitem.title: USA: Conn Gov undecided on using bonds for UConn - paper.
newsitem.headline: Conn Gov undecided on using bonds for UConn - paper.

text.p: Connecticut Gov. George Rowland still is deciding whether to spend $30 million in state bond funds to help the University of Connecticut expand its research arm, the Hartford Courant said on Thursday.
The health center has proposed building an 11-story tower in Farmington that would include more than eight floors of laboratories for basic and advanced research.

Rowland, who spoke at a regional governors' conference, said that the university had long been overshadowed by Yale University's research and that the state "just now is recognizing some of the assets we have in our state."
